annotations.title: Show or stop showing the site at a domain

description: Turns "Show my Gemmein site here" on (show: true) or "Stop showing my site here" (show: false) for one domain already added to this app — the same switch as the dashboard's Domains page and `npx gemmein domains show|hide`, with the same refusals (not this app's domain, not proved yours yet, a domain that only sends the app's email). On: the app's Live site shows at the domain once its one record is in place (the answer names it). Off: the site stops answering at that address; the domain stays verified, and sign-in and email keep working; it can be shown again any time. While the app is in Development it acts at once; on a Live app it asks the founder to approve it in their browser (with the code Gemmein emails and, when they set one up, their authenticator app's code), and approving carries it out — live_action_status reads what happened. Only for a domain the founder wants their Gemmein site at — never one whose site is hosted elsewhere. Each change is on the founder's Logs.

domain.description: a domain this app has, like example.com

note.description: one sentence for your human, shown under Gemmein's own summary (Live only)

show.description: true: show the Gemmein site there; false: stop showing it
